<entry id="N00512">
<head-word>נֶחֶמְתָּא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key> ch. = h.</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="N00505">נֶחָמָה.</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. נֶחֱמָתָא, נַחֲמַן</plural-form>. Targ. Y. Gen. I, 21. Targ. Is. XVIII, 4 (ed. Lag. נִיחֲמַן); a. fr.—B. Kam. 38
<sup>a</sup> מאי אית לי גבי נ' דבבלאי what do I care for the consolations of the Babylonians? B. Bath. 14
<sup>b</sup> וסיפיה נ' and ends with consolations. Ib. סמכינן … ונ' לנ' we join … the consolations at the end of one book to those at the beginning of the next, v. חוּרְבָּנָא.—Y. Snh. X, 28
<sup>b</sup> bot. וכל טבן ונ' וכ' and all the good times and consolations (predicted) in the world have come true in my own days.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00513">
<head-word>נַחְנָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<plural-form>pl. of אֲנָא</plural-form>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00514">
<head-word>נְחַץ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. חצץ I a. חוּץ I) 
<italic>to squeeze in, strap</italic>.</definition>
<notes>
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. נְחִיץ 
<italic>closely corded</italic>. Y. Meg. III, 74
<sup>c</sup> bot. (not נחת), v. קוּנְטְרָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00515">
<head-word>נָחַר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (sec. r. of חור, חרר) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to perforate</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to kill by stabbing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. V, 3 הנוֹחֵר if one stabs (instead of cutting according to ritual). Pes. 49
<sup>b</sup> מותר לנוֹחֲרוֹ you may stab him.—[Sifra Aḥăré, Par. 9, ch. XIII שלא תנחור, read: תְנַחֵשׁ, v. נָחַשׁ; Rabad תנקור, v. נָקַר II.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of נְחִירַיִם) 
<italic>to discharge mucus, run</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. 64
<sup>b</sup> כל זמן שנוֹחֶרֶת as long as the healing wound discharges matter. V. נְחִירָה.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיחַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be stabbed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 17
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to ישחט, Num. XI, 22) יִנָּחֵר להם מיבעיא ליה (not ניחר) if no ritual cutting was prescribed for the people in the desert, the text ought to have read, ‘shall be stabbed for them’.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיחֵר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of נחירים) 
<italic>to snort</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 94
<sup>a</sup> (play on ס̇נ̇ח̇ר̇יב) שס̇ח̇ ונ̇יח̇ר̇ וכ' he spoke and snorted forth words against heaven.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00516">
<head-word>נְחַר</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to stab</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 40.—Gitt. 69
<sup>a</sup> ולִיחֲרוּ לכלבא וכ' and let them stab the dog in the pupil of his eye.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to blow the nose, sneeze, to give a sign by means of a nasal sound</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 68
<sup>a</sup> נ' ליה רב וכ' R. Ḥ. uttered a sound of warning behind him. Sabb. 152
<sup>b</sup> נ' בהו וכ' R. A. (who was buried there) snorted at them (warned them off; Ag. Hatt. נהם). R. Hash. 34
<sup>b</sup> כי נְחִירְנָא לך (ed. נהירנא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) when I give thee a sign. Ber. 62
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נַחֵר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to rebuke</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 81
<sup>b</sup> נַחֲרוּ ביה they rebuked him (for his misbehavior).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00517">
<head-word>נַחַרְתָּא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>wrath</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Gen. R. s. 67 (ref. to Am. I, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes> עוברתיה ונַחַרְתֵּיה וכ' his anger and his wrath do not cease &c.; Yalk. ib. 116 וזחרתיה (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00518">
<head-word>נָחַשׁ</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. לחש)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to whisper</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיחֵשׁ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to divine, to make action dependent on an omen, to augur</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sabb. VII (VIII), 13 איזהו מְנַחֵשׁ וכ' a diviner (under the law, Lev. XIX, 26) is he who says, ‘my staff fell out of my hand’ (it portends evil) &c.; Snh. 65
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. 66
<sup>a</sup> כגון אלו המְנַחֲשִׁים בחולדה וכ' like those who divine (evil or luck) from a weasel, birds &c. Y. Sabb. VI, end, 8
<sup>d</sup> כל המנחש סופו לבוא עליו if one believes in omens, what he fears will finally befall him (with ref. to לא נחש Num. XXIII, 23, changed into לו נחש); Ned. 32
<sup>a</sup> כל המנחש לו נחש for him who believes in omens, the omen exists (will be realized). Ib. כל אדם שאינו מנ' he who rejects divination. Mekh. B’shall. s. 2 שמא יְנַחֲשׁוּ ויחזרו וכ' lest they consider it a bad omen and go back. Ib. וזקני מדין נִחֲשׁוּ וכ' and the Midianite elders considered (Balaam’s death) a bad omen and went home; a. fr.—Sifra Vayikra, Par. 9, ch. XIII (ref. to Lev. XVIII, 3) [read:] שלא תְנַחֵשׁ thou must not augur (v. however, נָקַר II).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00519">
<head-word>נְחַשׁ</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Pa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נַחֵישׁ, נָ' same. Targ. II Kings XXI, 6. Ib. XVII, 17 (ed. Wil. ונְחִישׁוּ 
<italic>Pe</italic>.); a. fr.—Ḥull. 95
<sup>b</sup> דנָחֵישׁ because he had made his movements dependent on an omen. Yeb. 120
<sup>b</sup> כיס … מְנַחֲשֵׁי אינשי וכ' as to purse and bag people are superstitious and do not lend them; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00520">
<head-word>נְחַשׁ</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Af</italic>.</definition>
<notes> אַנְחֵשׁ, הַנְחֵשׁ (denom. of נְחָשׁ) 
<italic>to use copper</italic> and plate it with silver, 
<italic>to plate</italic>. Pesik. Ekhah, p. 122
<sup>b</sup> הַנְחֵשׁ ליה make it plated for him (in place of solid silver); Yalk. Is. 258 אכחיש, read: אַנְ'.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00521">
<head-word>נַחַשׁ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> נָֹחַשׁ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>divination from omen, superstition</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 20 בעל נ' a believer in omens. Ned. 32
<sup>a</sup>, v. נָחַשׁ. Y. Sabb. VI, 8
<sup>c</sup> bot. אע"פ שאין נ' יש סימן although you must not make them an omen, they are a sign (presage); Ḥull. 95
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. כל נ' שאינו … אינו נ' an omen which is not proposed in the manner of Eliezer … (Gen. XXIV, 13, sq.) or of Jonathan (I Sam. XIV, 9, sq.) is not considered a divination (in the sense of Lev. XIX, 26); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. נְחָשִׁים</plural-form>. Tanḥ. Balak 4 בעל נ', v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00522">
<head-word>נָחָשׁ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> נָחַשׁ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>the hissing</italic>,] 
<italic>serpent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 22 נ' הקדמוני the original serpent (the seducer of Eve). Ib. s. 20 נ' זה רשע בעל תשובות that serpent is wicked and skilled in arguments. Bekh. 8
<sup>a</sup> נ' לשבע שנים וכ' a serpent’s pregnancy lasts seven years, and for that wicked animal I find no parallel (in the vegetable kingdom). Gen. R. s. 54 הנ' של בית the domestic serpent (harmless); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. נְחָשִׁים</plural-form>. Ib. s. 84 נ' ועקרבים snakes and scorpions; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a pungent</italic> (
<italic>poisonous</italic>) 
<italic>fluid</italic> in the leaves or in the stems of onions kept for a long time in the ground.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 29
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a disease of the eye</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="H01013">חִלָּזוֹן</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Bekh. VI, 2 חלזון נ' וכ', expl. ib. 38
<sup>b</sup> as identical with חלזון; Tosef. ib. IV, 2; Sifra Emor ch. II, Par. 3.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00523">
<head-word>נַחַשׁ</head-word>
<head-word>נַחֲשָׁא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. = h.</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="N00518">נַחַשׁ.</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Y. II Num. XXIII, 23.—
<pgbrk id="pg897" /> Snh. 19
<sup>a</sup> נ' קא רמי להו (by saying to his comforters, ‘be comforted’) does he not cast an evil omen on them (that they would suffer bereavement)? Gen. R. s. 87, v. הָן; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. נַחְשִׁין, נַחְשַׁיָּא, נְחָ'</plural-form>. Targ. Num. l. c. (O. ed. Berl. נַחַשַׁ'). Targ. O. ib. XXIV, 1. Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 26; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00524">
<head-word>נְחָשׁ</head-word>
<head-word>, (, </head-word>
<head-word>נְחַשׁ</head-word>
<head-word>,) , </head-word>
<head-word>נְחָשָׁא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> m. ch. = h. נְחוֹשֶׁת. Targ. Jer. XV, 20. Targ. Num. XXI, 9; a. fr.—Y. Kidd. I, 58
<sup>d</sup> נ' יקיר נ' זליל copper rises and falls (silver being the standard), v. 
<xref rid="J00575">יֵקִּירָא</xref>. Esth. R. to I, 22 (ר' עזריה) מה דהדין קיתונא דנ' וכ' what purpose this copper vessels serves, an earthen vessel may serve as well; Lev. R. s. 12 (not נחשת); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00525">
<head-word>נַחְשׁוֹל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (חָשַׁל; Syr.</definition>
<notes> מחשולא, P. Sm. 1404) 
<italic>a crushing wind</italic> (cmp. I Kings XIX, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>; esp. (שבים) נ' 
<italic>gale on high sea</italic>, also 
<italic>Na</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>shol</italic>, a spirit.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Yoma II, 4; Yoma 38
<sup>a</sup> (Y. ib. III, 41
<sup>a</sup> סער גדול). Tosef. B. Mets. VII, 14; B. Kam. 116
<sup>b</sup>; Y. B. Mets. VI, end, 11
<sup>a</sup> ספינה שעמד עליה נ' והיקל וכ' if a gale threatened the ship, and they lighted it. Pesik. R. s. 32 אחזו נחשולה (corr. acc.). Num. R. s. 13 (play on נחשון) על שם שירד תחלה לנ' שבים because he was the first to go down to the surf (or to Naḥshol) in the sea. Gitt. 56
<sup>b</sup> עמד עליו נ' שבים וכ' a 
<italic>na</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>shol</italic> in the sea stood up against him to drown him; Yalk. Koh. 972 נ' של ים.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00526">
<head-word>נַחְשׁוֹל</head-word>
<head-word>נַחְשׁוֹלָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Jon. I, 4. Ib. 15; a. e.—Lev. R. s. 22 מחא נ' בימא a 
<italic>na</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>shol</italic> smote the sea; Gen. R. s. 10 מחאיה נחשלא בימא (corr. acc.); Koh. R. to V, 8 מחא נ' גו ימא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00527">
<head-word>נַחְשׁוֹן</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.)
<pos> pr. n. m.</pos>
<italic>Nahshon</italic>, prince of the tribe of Judah.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 13, v. נַחְשׁוֹל h. Snh. 12
<sup>a</sup> (in a secret letter) עמוסי יריכי נ' the burdened (the officers) of the offspring of N., i.e. of the Nasi of Palestine; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00528">
<head-word>נַחְשִׁירְכָן</head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (not נחשיד')
<pos> m.</pos> (Pers., v. Nöld. Mand. Gramm. p. 63) 
<italic>hunter; a shrewd man</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. XXV, 27 (h. text ידע ציד; cmp. Gen. R. s. 63; Tanḥ. Tol’doth 8).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>

<notes>, v. 
<xref rid="N00526">נַחְשׁוֹלָא</xref></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>

<notes>, v. 
<xref rid="N00528">נַחְשִׁירְכָן</xref></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00531">
<head-word>נְחשֶׁת</head-word>
<head-word>נְחֻשְׁתָּן</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>, v. 
<xref rid="N00480">נְחוֹשֶׁת</xref>,

<entry id="N00532">
<head-word>נַחַת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> נוּחַ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>rest, tray, stand</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="A02156">אַנְחוּתָה</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Ḥag. 26
<sup>b</sup>; Men. 96
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. כלי עץ העשוי לנ' a wooden utensil intended for resting things on it (table &c.). Gen. R. s. 25; s. 33 לשם נ' התיבה נקרא Noah was named from the resting of the ark (Gen. VIII, 4). Yeb. 103
<sup>b</sup> סנדל של נ' ע"ז Ar. (in ed. our w. omitted) a sandal used as a rest for an idol.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>ease; gentleness; comfort</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 83
<sup>b</sup> שלזה תשמישו בנ' which one neighbor can make use of with ease, opp. בקשה with difficulty. Ber. 56
<sup>b</sup> בנ' at a slow trot, opp. ברדוף at full speed. Snh. 92
<sup>a</sup>, v. נָהַג; a. fr.—נ' רוח 
<italic>gratification, pleasure</italic>. Keth. 95
<sup>a</sup> תימא נ' ר' עשיתי לבעלי she may say, I did it only to gratify my husband (but did not mean to sell). Ḥag. 16
<sup>b</sup> כדי לעשות נ' ר' לנשים to let the (offering) women have the satisfaction (of putting their hands on the sacrifices). Ber. 17
<sup>a</sup> ועושה נ' ר' ליוצרו and acts so as to please his Creator; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00533">
<head-word>נָחַת</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> sec. r. of נוּחַ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be put down, to go down</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִחַת</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same, 
<italic>to be humbled, bow</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. IV, beg. 7
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Mal. II, 5) קודם … נ' הוא before he mentions the Name (in the benediction), he must bow.—V. חָתָא.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00534">
<head-word>נְחַת</head-word>
<head-word>נְחֵית</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to go down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Impf. יֵחוֹת, inf. מֵיחָת, מֵיחוּת, imper. חוֹת. Targ. Ex. XV, 5. Targ. Y. Gen. XLIV, 26; a. fr.—[Targ. Y. II Gen. XLIX, 23 למִנְחֲתָא, some ed. למִנְחַתָּא, read: למְנַחֲתָא 
<italic>Pa</italic>.]—Sabb. 41
<sup>a</sup> כי נָחֵית when one is going down (to bathe). Ib. כי קא נָחֲתֵי when they were going down. Meg. 25
<sup>a</sup> ההוא דנ' וכ' a man went down (to the praying desk) in the presence of &c. B. Kam. 39
<sup>a</sup> נ' לעומק וכ' goes down to the depth of the law; a. fr.—B. Bath. 133
<sup>a</sup> נַחֲתָא לדיקלא she seizes the palm-tree for her widowhood, v. יָרַד.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נַחֵית</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to put down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 47
<sup>a</sup> ונַחֲתֵיה וכ' and let him put down the pan; v. חֲתֵי I.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<entry id="N00571">

<senses>
<sense>

<definition>

<sup>d</sup> bot., a. e. ומה שכר נָטְלוּ על כך what reward did they get for it?—Sifra Sh’mini, beg. מסיני נטלו להם they got (their punishment) from Sinai. Sabb. 151
<sup>b</sup> טוֹל מה וכ' take away what thou hast put into me. Arakh. 16
<sup>b</sup>; B. Bath. 15
<sup>b</sup> טול קיסם מבין עיניך (Ag. Hatt. שיניך) remove the chip from between thy eyes (teeth); טול קורה וכ' remove the beam from &c. Gitt. VI, 1 אף האומרת טול לי גטי even if she says, get me my letter of divorce (instead of ‘receive for me’). Ib. 78
<sup>a</sup> טְלִי גיטיך וכ' take up thy letter of divorce from the ground. Pesik. R. s. 26, end נָטַלְתִּי עיני I lifted up my eyes. Ber. II, 8 לא כל הרוצה לִיטּוֹל לו את השם יִטּוֹל Y. ed., not every one who desires to assume a name, may assume it, i.e. not 
<pgbrk id="pg900" />every one has a right to consider himself superior to the masses (v. יוֹהֲרָא); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. נָטוּל; f. נְטוּלָה 
<italic>removed</italic>. Ned. XI, 12 (if a woman says) נ' אני מן היהודים I will be removed from (keep no company with) Jews; יפר … ותהא נ' וכ' the husband may forbid the vow as far as it concerns himself, and (for the rest) let her be isolated &c.—Snh. 21
<sup>b</sup> נְטוּלֵי טחול persons who had their milt cut out (to make them fast runners).—V. נְטוּלָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (sub. מים) 
<italic>to pour water over one’s hands</italic> for purification; נ' לידים, (ellipt.) נ' ידים, or only נ' 
<italic>to wash the hands</italic> before and after meals, before prayer &c. Tosef. Yad. I, 1 מי רביעית נוֹטְלִין לידים וכ' (Var. ed. Zuck., a. Mish. ib. I, 1 נותנין) a quantity of one fourth of a Log of water may be used for pouring over the hands of one person &c. Ib.</definition>
<notes> 13 הנוֹטֵל לידים הנוטל מתכוין והנותן וכ' if a person had his hands washed, himself having the intention (of purification), while he who poured it had not. Ib. 2; Mish. ib. II, 3 נ' את הראשונים if he began to use the water for washing before the meal (v. מַיִם). Ḥull. 107
<sup>a</sup> נוטלין ממנו לידים you may use it for washing the hands; Tosef. l. c. 6. Ber. VIII, 2. Ib. 51
<sup>a</sup> אל תִּטּוֹל ידיך ממי וכ' have not water poured over thy hands by one who has not washed his hands &c. Ḥull. 105
<sup>a</sup> נוטלין … בכלי you must wash over a vessel (receiving the water); ע"ג קרקע on the floor; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be handled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. XVII, 1 (122
<sup>b</sup>) כל הכלים נִיטְּלִין בשבת all vessels (implements, utensils &c.) may be handled on the Sabbath. Ib. 43
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. אין כלי נ' אלא לדבר הנ' בשבת a utensil must not be handled on the Sabbath except for the protection of a thing which may be used on the Sabbath. Par. V, 9 והן יכולות להִנָּטֵל וכ' and they can be handled simultaneously; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be removed, be gone</italic>.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> ה' לבעלת וכ' if he attached the fringe (תְּכֵלֶת) to a three-cornered garment. Sabb. 42
<sup>b</sup> להַטִּיל ביצתה to lay her eggs; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of plants) 
<italic>to assume the shape of, to develop.</italic></definition>

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּטָּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>

<notes> Part. מוּטָּל, f. מוּטֶּלֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מוּטָּלִים, מוּטָּלִין; מוּטָּלוֹת</plural-form> a) 
<italic>lying</italic>. Kidd. 82

<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>

<sup>b</sup> דילמא … והוא נ' קא מפיק שמא perhaps he sold them, and he himself spread the report (that they had been stolen). Ber. 58
<sup>b</sup> לא ידענא מאי נ' I do not know what it is (its nature). Taan. 24
<sup>a</sup> אנא נ' (differ. in Ms. M.) I am he (of whom you are speaking). Pes. 104
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. מאן נ' בנן וכ' (Ms. M. נינהו, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) who is (are) meant by ‘the son of saints’?; a. fr.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. נִיהִי. Ber. 44
<sup>a</sup>.—
<plural-form>Pl. נִינְהוּ, נִנְהוּ</plural-form>. Ḥull. 38
<sup>a</sup> מאי נ' דברים וכ' what are the movements indicating the agony of death? Ib. 79
<sup>a</sup> כולהו חדא מינא נ' they all belong to the same species. B. Mets. 24
<sup>b</sup> רובה ישראל ננהו the majority are Jews; a. fr.—With suffixes: נִיהֲלִי, נִיהֲלָךְ, נִיהֲלֵיה &c. (
<italic>to</italic>) 
<italic>myself, thyself, himself</italic> &c. Ḥull. 59
<sup>b</sup> בעינא דמחזית ליה ניהלי (Rashi דמחזית ניהליה) I want thee to show him to 
<italic>me</italic> (Rashi: to make him visible). Ib. 142
<sup>a</sup> והדר לקנינהו נ' and then let him transfer them to thyself. Ber. 54
<sup>b</sup> בריך רחמנא דיהבך נִיהֲלָן וכ' blessed be the Merciful who returned thee to 
<italic>us</italic> and not to the dust. Ned. 41
<sup>a</sup>; Erub. 10
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. את אמרת ניהלן וכ' thou didst cite it to ourselves &c. Keth. 92
<sup>a</sup> מגבי להו נִיהֲלַיְיהוּ ארעא he will give land in payment to the very claimants, and then seize it from them; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>

<italic>ease</italic>,

<notes> Yeb. 118
<sup>b</sup> נ' דגופא וכ' bodily comfort (even in an unhappy marriage) is preferable (to singleness). Snh. 45
<sup>a</sup>, v. בִּזְיוֹנָא. Sabb. 132
<sup>a</sup> מעיקרא מאי קא נ' ליה וכ' what satisfactory reason had he at first (for his interpretation), and what was again the objection he attempted to meet?—נ' ל־ 
<italic>one likes, prefers</italic>. Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 50.—Meg. 28
<sup>a</sup> אתייקורי … לא נ' לי I do not want to be honored at the expense of thy disgrace. Ib. לא נ' לכו וכ' do you not want me to live? B. Bath. 172
<sup>a</sup> מילתא דנ' ליה וכ' something which is satisfactory to the creditor and &c. Arakh. 30
<sup>b</sup> נ' לאיניש דליזבן וכ' it is better for man to sell his daughter than to borrow on interest. Erub. 32
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—נִ', הָנִ' (a dialectical term, v. נוּחַ 
<italic>Ithpe.</italic>) 
<italic>it is right; it will do</italic>. Y. Pes. I, 27
<sup>b</sup> top נ' העליונים וכ' this is right as far as the uppermost and nethermost cavities are concerned. Y. Yoma III, 40
<sup>c</sup>, sq. אין תימר מיד נ' אין תימר … נ' של משה וכ' if you say, sacred vessels are consecrated at once (as soon as finished), it is right; but if you say, they are not consecrated until they are used, it would be right as far as the Mosaic vessels are concerned, but &c.—Ḥull. 56
<sup>a</sup>
<sup />
<pgbrk id="pg904" />הנ' למאן דאמר this would be right according to the opinion of &c.; a. fr.—Cant. R. to I, 6 נ' (an editorial gloss, as a punctuation mark) 
<italic>as a positive assertion</italic>, opp. אִתְמְהָא.—V. נְיָיח.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
